Thanks for the ping. My recommendation for a first iteration:

1) Email primary + portal opt-in: deliver a standard PDF invoice to billing@acme-corp.com and simultaneously create the invoice in our portal (they get an invite link). That avoids delays while they complete portal enrollment.
2) Include VAT fields and our Tax ID on the invoice PDF. If they require reverse-charge paperwork, we can attach a VAT declaration PDF to each invoice or host proof in the portal.
3) Provide XML/UBL on request — we have a schema but need to produce a sample for their AP team to validate.
4) Remit instructions: use our finance@redwood.com bank details (I will confirm exact details once sign-off).

Action items I can take: generate a PDF sample and an example UBL XML using PO 98765. Suggest billing contact in invoice header: finance@redwood.com (CC ap@acme-corp.com).

If Kimberly prefers a different path for pilots, happy to adjust.

—Connor

- The invoice PDF contains: invoice number, issue date, due date, PO 98765, VAT fields (supplier VAT and a line for buyer VAT ID / reverse-charge note).
- Include a one-line billing contact and an AP contact (ap@acme-corp.com) in the header.
- Add a note about accepted formats: "PDF preferred; XML (UBL) available on request."
- If they request automated delivery (SFTP/webhook), route to the integrations team after AP confirms credentials.

I'll approve email-first + portal invite. Connor: please prepare XML schema sample and confirm bank remit details. Rachel: when you send the sample to Acme, cc operations-portal@redwood.com so we can trigger the invitation flow.
